name: Alila Napa Valley
insider_take: This ultra-luxe retreat sits on 157 acres of pristine wilderness in the heart of Napa Valley, where world-class wine meets untouched nature.
whats_special: Alila Napa Valley is the first luxury resort built in Napa Valley in over a decade, featuring stunning contemporary architecture that blends seamlessly with the rugged landscape. The property boasts an award-winning spa with treatments using locally-sourced ingredients and offers exclusive access to some of Napa's most coveted wineries through private helicopter tours.
pro_tip: Book the "Vintner's Table" experience for an intimate dinner prepared by the resort's chef using ingredients from their on-site organic garden, paired with rare wines from neighboring estates not available to the public.
dont_miss: The sunrise hot air balloon rides over the valley (weather permitting) and the resort's signature "Forest Bathing" wellness experience led by certified guides through the property's ancient oak groves. The infinity pool overlooking Las Posadas Forest offers some of the most Instagram-worthy sunset views in all of Napa.
pros: Prime Napa Valley wine country location with vineyard views
Contemporary luxury design with sustainable practices
Farm-to-table dining featuring local Napa ingredients
cons: Adults-focused atmosphere may not suit families
